interpretation: Functional sensory-motor curriculum inspired by simpler behaviors; not an inferred evolutionary lineage

shared_rules.input: Environmental fields through sensory transduction, actual-body proprioception; no target phase, motor current or prescribed muscle waveform
trainable: three exploratory chemical/B/DVA transduction gain multipliers
shared_rules.bounds: Original winner7001 factor2 for neurons/connections; .5..2 times original nonzero defaults for sensory gains
shared_rules.provenance: New objective, fresh RNG; preserve all prior checkpoints, source/environment/invocation and recursive lineage outside Git
shared_rules.biological_scope: Engineering gates are not experimental diacetyl reflex targets or calibrated wet-substrate behavior
shared_rules.progression: User-authorized E072->E073 only after complete checkpoint-specific sensory-state validation; changed swimming weights revalidate all control gates. No other automatic promotion.

stages.motor_goal: One cue-specific reversible bend, no preferred side
stages.sensory_goal: AWA recruitment by finite diacetyl exposure and recovery after washout; actual-body B/DVA feedback active and gain trainable
stages.unforced_scope: Matched sham records spontaneous activity; cue response does not establish autonomous oscillation
stages.ladder_policy: Only first target is active. Each promotion requires reviewed validation and a new objective/configuration; not an automatic or demonstrated progression.

training_selection.aggregation: maximum of nominal and low-dose response losses plus unchanged prior
training_selection.initialization: inherit selected neural/sensory parameters; fresh seed5700/global0

stages.motor_goal: Several opposing bends after a single initiating event, without a periodic teacher
stages.sensory_goal: Local actual-body feedback participates in alternation; stimulus can initiate an event but does not pace cycles
stages.validation: Post-cue persistence and separate no-cue autonomy assay; feedback block, perturbation and timestep tests
stages.protocol: 12s; one odor exposure2..3s; actual post-cue joint pattern4..12s; matched sham separately
stages.scope: Short-window pattern prerequisite; no long autonomy, biological frequency, propagation or propulsion claim
stages.diagnosis: No detected qualifying neural or downstream repetitions in baseline or fitted saved traces; E064 server diagnostic

stages.motor_goal: Recruit adjacent regions with consistent lag and distributed amplitude
stages.sensory_goal: Train proprioceptive recruitment from actual curvature; test altered feedback and physical load
stages.validation: Distributed persistent motion, phase-lag evidence, feedback interventions; no implied propulsion

stages.motor_goal: Waves produce useful displacement in water and on a wet substrate
stages.sensory_goal: Closed-loop adjustment to physical load with actual-body feedback
stages.validation: Equal-phase displacement, numerical convergence, energy/force constraints and medium-specific evidence

stages.motor_goal: Start, stop, reverse and turn within continuous trajectories
stages.sensory_goal: Environmental cues and internal state select motor programs; navigation only after viable skills
stages.validation: One parameter set without state resets or checkpoint swaps; held-out cue schedules and tasks

stages.motor_goal: Sensory stop -> sustained rest -> sensory restart, with repeated/idempotent commands
stages.sensory_goal: Learned AWA/ASE bath-cue association through existing interneuron network; not an innate reflex claim
stages.input: Brief environmental chemical cues; actual body feedback; no direct controller/motor commands
stages.qualification: All positive control gates, independent cue blocks, and at least one non-paralyzing controller output intervention

stages.motor_goal: Positive directed movement through water with nonreciprocal closed shape cycles, while preserving start/stop
stages.mandatory: Revalidate control on exact changed swimming checkpoint; parent gate alone insufficient

continuation: Preserve all E067 candidates; no next run launched. Improve evaluation efficiency and inspect fixed output interface before longer search.
